items.title: Anthropic推出的水印在两款老式Claude模特身上留下了一个漏洞
items.summary: Anthropic正在将其文本水印扩展到另外四个Claude模型，以满足欧盟人工智能法案12月的最后期限。在旧型号的Claude Opus 4.6和Sonnet 4.6上，开发人员可以通过调整单个采样参数来绕过水印。
items.titleOriginal: Anthropic's watermark rollout leaves a loophole on two older Claude models
items.summaryOriginal: Anthropic is expanding its text watermark to four more Claude models to meet the EU AI Act's December deadline. On the older models Claude Opus 4.6 and Sonnet 4.6, developers can bypass the watermark by tweaking a single sampling parameter.
